name: Soft 3D
author: Grok Bot
blurb: Matte soft-3D clay for a quiet wellness hour: peach-cream ground, lilac accents, pillow cards with a warm seam edge, one near-black pill for the commit action, and an original pebble family (the Puffets) modeled with radial volume, a broad highlight, and a contact shadow.

tagline.en: Peach clay, sleepy volume, one black pill
tagline.zh: 蜜桃黏土，软萌体积，一颗黑胶囊

origin.author: Grok Bot
origin.note: Authored by Grok Bot. Original Soft 3D system. A user-supplied Xiaohongshu still of a pastel wellness app was used as mood only and is not in the repo. The Puffet family, palette, screens, and copy are original. No upstream assets.
